description.value: Robinhood Liquor Store is a neighbourhood retail liquor store on 72nd Avenue in Surrey carrying beer, wine, and spirits with monthly rotating specials and a loyalty program through More Rewards. The store offers delivery via Skip the Dishes and DoorDash in addition to in-person shopping. A touring cyclist could stop here to resupply on beverages, though no cycling-specific amenities are advertised on the website.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and confirms an operational liquor store, but the address on the website (13468 72 Ave, Surrey, BC V3W 2N8) directly contradicts the OSM community tag of 'Tsawwassen' — these are distinct municipalities, suggesting the OSM record is geographically misassigned or mislabelled. The OSM name 'Robin Hood Liquor Store' (two words) also differs from the website's consistent usage of 'Robinhood Liquor Store' (one word). Neither the website nor the OSM tags mention bike parking, water refill, or washrooms, so all required WWC cycling criteria remain unconfirmed.
